notFoundDescription: It may belong to another organization, or the link is wrong.
createdWithoutPrice: The product was added, but its price wasn't saved. Enter it again on this page.
conflict: This product changed elsewhere in the meantime. Your edits are kept — reload the latest version and apply them again.
saveFirst: Save the product first; then you can add images, stock counts and agreed buyer prices.
name: Name
skuHint: Letters, digits, dot, slash, hyphen or underscore, up to 64 characters. Earlier SKUs of your products stay reserved.
unitHint: A unit is needed before activation. Manage units under Categories, tags & units.
frozen: Unit and pack are fixed because this product has been ordered.
quantityHint: Buyers order at least the minimum, then in steps (minimum 6, step 6: 6, 12, 18…).
pricingDescription: Net prices excluding VAT, in {currency}. Agreed buyer prices replace these; one promotion can lower the price further.
basePriceHint: Leave empty while the product isn't priced yet.
tiersDescription: Lower unit prices from a quantity upwards. Each tier starts above the minimum, on an order step, and costs less than the one before.

stateDescription.ACTIVE: Connected buyers can see and order it.
stateDescription.INACTIVE: Hidden from buyers. Prices, stock and history are kept.
stateDescription.ARCHIVED: Hidden and not counted toward your plan. Restoring makes it inactive.

activateHint: Activation needs a unit, a base price and — with stock tracking on — a confirmed stock count.
archiveDescription: It disappears from buyers and stops counting toward your plan. Its SKU, prices, stock and order history are kept, and you can restore it later.
featuredDescription: Shown to buyers as a highlight while the product is active.

errors.skuInvalid: Use up to 64 letters, digits, dots, slashes, hyphens or underscores.
errors.tooManyTags: A product can have at most {max} tags.
errors.wholeQuantity: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
errors.priceInvalid: Enter a positive price with at most two decimals, e.g. 19,60.
errors.tierAboveMinimum: A tier must start above the minimum order ({min}).
errors.tierStep: A tier must start on an order step: {min} plus a multiple of {step}.
errors.tierDuplicate: Two tiers start at the same quantity.
errors.tierNotLower: Each tier must cost less than the tier before it.
errors.tierNotBelowBase: A tier must cost less than the base price.
errors.baseForTiers: Volume tiers need a base price.

image.title: Images
image.description: Up to {count} JPEG, PNG or WebP images, {mb} MB each. The first one is the main image.
image.processingSlow: The image is still being processed. Keep this page open, or check again later.
image.tooLarge: Images can be at most {mb} MB.
image.wrongType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
image.full: A product can have at most {count} images.
